description_en: Unregisters a custom face or all faces under a specific custom person
description_zh: 注销⼀张⾃定义⼈脸，或者注销某个⾃定义⼈物下的所有⼈脸
kebab_example: aliyun mts unregister-custom-face --category-id CategoryId001-0000 --person-id PersonId001-0000 --face-id 150000 --api-version 2014-06-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UnregisterCustomFace

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person library. It uniquely identifies a custom person library and is generated by the caller. The caller must ensure its uniqueness.
<notice>It cannot be the same as a system person library ID. If they are the same, the system person library is used by default. The ID can be up to 120 characters in length, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is not case-sensitive. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物库ID。⽤于唯⼀标识⼀个⾃定义⼈物库，由调⽤者⽣成，调⽤者⾃⼰保证唯⼀性。
<notice>不能与系统⼈物库ID相同 ，如相同则默认使用系统人物库。最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。></notice>
parameters.name: category_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the person. It uniquely identifies a custom person. The caller must ensure its uniqueness.

The ID can be up to 120 characters in length, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is not case-sensitive. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation. If you set this parameter to ALL, all faces under the specified CategoryId are unregistered, and the person library is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
⼈物ID。用于唯一标识一个自定义人物。由调用者自己保证唯一性。

最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。如果填“ALL”，表示注销该CategoryId下所有⼈脸，同时删除该人物库
parameters.name: person_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the face. It uniquely identifies a face. The caller must ensure its uniqueness.

The ID can be up to 120 characters in length, supports both Chinese and English characters, and is not case-sensitive. You can obtain the ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html operation. If you set this parameter to ALL, all faces under the specified PersonId are unregistered
parameters.help_zh:
人脸ID。用于唯一标识一张人脸，由调用者自己保证唯一性。

最⻓⽀持120字符，不限中英文，不区分⼤⼩写。可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/187787.html接口查询。如果填“ALL”，表示注销该PersonId下所有⼈脸
parameters.name: face_id
